about: every p that moved when North Carolina's State Board route took its November deciding rounds (the orchestrator, 2026-11-07 09:53 UTC: a November contest that follows an earlier round of the same contest that year is that contest's deciding round, in odd and even years alike). The deciding rounds get p by the route's classes ('D'); they also enter the route's pool of like races, so classes that now reach 100 earlier like races get p ('N'), and the other p of the same classes in later years move ('P'). Before is null where p was not computed. data/local/REPORT.md section 9. Written by worker D3 at 2026-11-07 10:05 UTC.

why_codes.D: a deciding round after an earlier round, now computed
why_codes.N: computed: its class now has 100 or more like races in earlier years
why_codes.P: moved: its class's like races in earlier years now include the deciding rounds
